additional_info.subject: RE: ID0417283-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / P8 170000973] Blurry HMI CRM:00645001015
additional_info.body:
Hi,
HMI was replaced half a year ago 26-09-2024, it’s been working fine since then until recently.
DLogic is okay since we have a new HMI. DP cable have also been replaced in the past. There for I unfortunately believe HMI needs to be replaced..
Question is this covered by warranty?
/Simen
-

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0417283-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / P8 170000973] Blurry HMI CRM:00645001015
additional_info.body:
Hi Simen,
We have checked remotely, and everything appears to be fine. We don't see any distortions, so it's most likely not a software issue. The problem could be related to the cable or the HMI. Before replacing the entire HMI, you can try connecting a monitor or another display using a DP cable.
Regarding the warranty, only the warranty team can assist you with this matter.
Thank you
Best Regards,
Vishal Dhiman
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
